notes: The application deadline (1 April - 15 July) is general ('valid for applicants from: all countries'), so it is a recurring deadline without a year. The pages do not give a separate deadline for non-EU applicants, so no dated applicationDeadline is output. Tuition: the DAAD page says the University of Passau does not charge tuition fees (as of April 2026), and the programme page quotes a student saying there are no tuition fees; the semester contribution of around 130 EUR is not tuition. Application channel: there is no dedicated non-EU sentence for this bachelor's programme; the uni-assist route is only visible on the general 'Termine und Fristen' page ('Bewerbungsschluss für grundständige Studiengänge über uni-assist'), not stated for the B.Sc. Artificial Intelligence specifically, so this is a manual check. Documents: the pages name the university entrance qualification and the aptitude tests, but no full document list or translation requirement is stated.
